note: Plan for one Entra app registration per workload. client_id values are local placeholders; the real ones come from `az ad app create` (docs/identity.md).

registrations.description: Customer-care planner. Interactive; acts as the signed-in user.
registrations.name: care-planner

registrations.description: CRM domain agent (Salesforce stand-in). User-scoped only: no app roles on CRM tools.
registrations.name: crm-agent

registrations.description: ERP/SAP domain agent. Hybrid: user token for customer data, own identity for order reference data.
registrations.name: erp-agent

registrations.description: Analytics agent. Reads shared KPI tables through the MCP gateway with its own identity.
registrations.name: data-agent

registrations.description: Accounts-payable language agent (extract, classify, draft). Called by the BPM as an activity.
registrations.name: ap-invoice-agent

registrations.description: Event worker for OrderCreated. Agent-scoped, no user.
registrations.name: worker-order-events

registrations.description: Event worker for ShipmentLate. Agent-scoped, no user.
registrations.name: worker-shipment-events

registrations.description: Durable Functions parent for vendor invoices. Agent-scoped; approver recorded as subject.
registrations.name: bpm-invoice-orchestrator

registrations.description: SAP middleware (Integration Suite / Event Mesh bridge) publishing canonical business events.
registrations.name: sap-integration-suite

registrations.description: Tool Gateway. Middle tier for Dataverse OBO pass-through.
registrations.name: tool-gateway

registrations.description: MCP Gateway. Calls MCP servers with its own identity.
registrations.name: mcp-gateway

registrations.description: Event Gateway. Validates and routes canonical business events.
registrations.name: event-gateway

registrations.description: A2A Gateway. Forwards caller tokens; holds no downstream rights of its own.
registrations.name: a2a-gateway

registrations.description: Identity Gateway API (api://aiip-identity-gateway). Workloads present their managed-identity token for this audience; the gateway's own MI is the federated credential of every agent registration.
registrations.name: identity-gateway
